question: Why is this teaching specifically imparted to the son of Gaṅgā?
premises: The teaching has been told to Gāṅgeya
Gāṅgeya is the best among Vaiṣṇavas
inference: The teaching is imparted to Gāṅgeya because he is the foremost among Vaiṣṇavas.
plain_english: This has been told to you, O son of Gaṅgā, because you are the best among Vaiṣṇavas.
